source_caption:
What if you’re almost 30 and still have no idea what you’re supposed to be doing with your life? The Worst Person in the World follows Julie, a woman approaching her thirties as she moves through relationships, career changes and the uncertainty of figuring out who she actually wants to be. Told across 12 chapters, the film explores love, commitment, ambition and the fear that some choices can’t simply be undone.

Directed by Joachim Trier and co-written with Eskil Vogt, the film is the final part of Trier’s unofficial “Oslo Trilogy,” following Reprise and Oslo, August 31st. Renate Reinsve won Best Actress at Cannes for her performance as Julie, while the film went on to receive Oscar nominations for Best International Feature Film and Best Original Screenplay.

source_details.synopsis: The Worst Person in the World (Norwegian: Verdens verste menneske) is a 2021 romantic comedy-drama film directed by Joachim Trier, who co-wrote the screenplay with Eskil Vogt. It is the third and final film in the director's Oslo trilogy, following Reprise (2006) and Oslo, August 31st (2011). The film premiered in competition at the 2021 Cannes Film Festival to widespread critical acclaim, with Renate Reinsve winning the award for Best Actress for her performance in the film. At the 94th Academy Awards, the film was nominated for Best International Feature Film and Best Original Screenplay.
